'''Rishi Station''', also known as '''Rishi Base''', was a [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] located on the [[Rishi moon]]. It warned [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] of any incoming [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] attacks. It was the location of a [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|battle]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], during which it was destroyed by clone trooper [[Hevy/Legends|Hevy]] in order to warn the Republic.

==History==
[[File:RishiStationCommandCenter-Rookies.png|thumb|left|200px|Rishi Station's command center]]
During the [[21 BBY/Legends|second year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] there was a [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|battle]], in which [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] killed four [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], including the base's commanding officer, [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[O'Niner/Legends|O'Niner]]. However, rookie clone troopers [[Hevy/Legends|Hevy]], [[Fives/Legends|Fives]], and [[Echo/Legends|Echo]], under the command of [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]], retook the base. Unfortunately, reinforcements arrived when [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] became suspicious of the lack of response. The clones tried to blow up the base with [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna gas]] and [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]], but the remote control was malfunctioning. Hevy manually detonated the explosives, destroying the listening post and killing himself in the process, to alert the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by disabling the All Clear signal.<ref name="Rookies" />
